excluded_policy: Excluded before any effect was computed: no complete approved persona exists in the release. Reported, never replaced by a hand-written profile.
persona_richness_note: Approved categorical dimensions sent per persona differ by study and by person. A cross-study comparison must read this table: a larger field count is not evidence that the persona is more accurate, but it is a confound for how much information the model received.

scoring_plan.primary: optimized versus original, per-person Brier, paired by person within stratum, 2000 draws
required_comparators: history (weighted option shares from non-evaluated respondents)
stratum_history (same, within stratum where at least 20 respondents exist)
scoring_plan.distribution: equal-card mean absolute share difference in percentage points
scoring_plan.gates: relative Brier improvement at least 2% with the 95% interval above zero; card-share improvement reported separately

authorization_note: User approved "zero-cost first, then anchor-v1 (384 calls, about 12-14 CNY)" on 2026-11-12 and topped up the balance to 998.13 CNY. Frozen plan is 576 jobs: 190 identical "optimized" requests were reused from wide-v1 at zero cost, leaving 384 real calls. Reserved peak 20.32 USD is the all-peak worst case; measured per-call cost from wide-v1 implies about 2.1 USD (15 CNY).

reuse.rule: same frozen request body hash, byte for byte; the optimized prompt is unchanged

execution_mode.claim: INSERT OR IGNORE inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE; one row per frozen body hash

completion.dedup_note: Six frozen jobs share a body hash with another job: two German respondents have identical approved persona dimensions, so the request text is identical. One call answers both; no answer was invented or copied.
completion.renormalise_note: First run rejected 57 answers whose probabilities summed to 1 +/- more than 1e-6 but less than 1%; the tolerance was widened to 1% with renormalisation and a counter, and every rejected call was recovered through the retained failure record. No answer was filled in by default.
completion.protocol_change_after_first_run: PROBABILITY_TOLERANCE 1e-6 -> 1e-2 with renormalisation, recorded per call
